title: Greying Population Stays in the Pink

sentences.en: Elderly people are growing healthier, happier and more independent, say American scientists.
sentences.zh: 美国科学家说,老年人越来越健康、更幸福、更独立。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The results of a 14-year study to be announced later this month reveal that the diseases associated with old age are afflicting fewer and fewer people and when they do strike, it is much later in life.
sentences.zh: 本月晚些时候将宣布的14年研究的结果显示,与老年有关的疾病对人们的影响越来越少,而当他们罢工时,它的生命就更晚了。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

words.def: 结果结果结果结果结果

sentences.en: In the last 14 years, the National Long-term Health Care Survey has gathered data on the health and lifestyles of more than 20,000 men and women over 65.
sentences.zh: 在过去14年中,全国长期保健调查收集了65岁以上20 000多名男女的健康和生活方式数据。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Researchers, now analysing the results of data gathered in 1994, say arthritis, high blood pressure and circulation problems -the major medical complaints in this age group – are troubling a smaller proportion every year.
sentences.zh: 研究人员现在分析1994年收集的数据结果,比如关节炎、高血压和循环问题,即这一年龄组的主要医疗投诉,每年令人担忧的比例都较低。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

words.def: 结果结果结果结果结果

sentences.en: And the data confirms that the rate at which these diseases are declining continues to accelerate.
sentences.zh: 数据证实这些疾病下降的速度继续加快。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Other diseases of old age – dementia, stroke, arteriosclerosis and emphysema – are also troubling fewer and fewer people.
sentences.zh: 其他老年疾病 — — 痴呆、中风、动脉硬化和肺气肿 — — 也越来越少,令人忧虑。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘It really raises the question of what should be considered normal ageing,’ says Kenneth Manton, a demographer from Duke University in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州杜克大学人口学家肯尼斯·曼顿(Kenneth Manton)说:「这真的提出了什么应该被认为是正常老龄化的问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: He says the problems doctors accepted as normal in a 65-year-old in 1982 are often not appearing until people are 70 or 75.
sentences.zh: 他说,医生在1982年被接受为65岁正常的65岁医生,在70岁或75岁之前,通常不会出现问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Clearly, certain diseases are beating a retreat in the face of medical advances.
sentences.zh: 显然,某些疾病正因医疗进步而退却。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But there may be other contributing factors.
sentences.zh: 但可能还有其他促成因素。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Improvements in childhood nutrition in the first quarter of the twentieth century, for example, gave today’s elderly people a better start in life than their predecessors.
sentences.zh: 例如,二十世纪第一季度儿童营养状况的改善使今天的老年人比其前辈的生活有一个更好的开端。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: On the downside, the data also reveals failures in public health that have caused surges in some illnesses.
sentences.zh: 数据也揭示出公共卫生方面的缺陷, 导致一些疾病激增。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: An increase in some cancers and bronchitis may reflect changing smoking habits and poorer air quality, say the researchers.
sentences.zh: 研究人员说,一些癌症和支气管炎的增加可能反映了吸烟习惯的改变和空气质量的下降。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘These may be subtle influences,’ says Manton, ‘but our subjects have been exposed to worse and worse pollution for over 60 years. It’s not surprising we see some effect.’
sentences.zh: 曼顿说: “ 这些可能是微妙的影响, ” 曼顿说: “ 但我们的臣民60多年来都遭受了更严重、更严重的污染。 我们并不奇怪,我们看到了一些效果。 ”

sentences.zh: 曼顿发现的一个有趣的关联是受过更好教育的人可能会活得更长

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For example, 65-year-old women with fewer than eight years of schooling are expected, on average, to live to 82.
sentences.zh: 例如,平均而言,受教育不到8年的65岁妇女平均预计活到82岁。

sentences.en: Those who continued their education live an extra seven years.

sentences.en: Although some of this can be attributed to a higher income, Manton believes it is mainly because educated people seek more medical attention.
sentences.zh: 虽然其中一些原因可以归因于收入较高,但Manton认为,这主要是因为受过教育的人寻求更多的医疗照顾。

sentences.en: The survey also assessed how independent people over 65 were, and again found a striking trend.
sentences.zh: 调查还评估了65岁以上的独立人士的情况,再次发现一个惊人的趋势。

sentences.en: Almost 80% of those in the 1994 survey could complete everyday activities ranging from eating and dressing unaided to complex tasks such as cooking and managing their finances.
sentences.zh: 1994年调查中几乎80%的人能够完成日常活动,从吃和穿衣,到烹饪和管理其财务等复杂任务。

sentences.en: That represents a significant drop in the number of disabled old people in the population.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: If the trends apparent in the United States 14 years ago had continued, researchers calculate there would be an additional one million disabled elderly people in today’s population.
sentences.zh: 如果14年前美国出现的趋势继续下去,研究人员估计今天人口中将再有100万残疾老年人。

sentences.en: According to Manton, slowing the trend has saved the United States government’s Medicare system more than $200 billion, suggesting that the greying of America’s population may prove less of a financial burden than expected.
sentences.zh: 曼顿认为, 减慢这一趋势已经挽救了美国政府医疗体系超过2 000亿美元, 这表明美国人口灰色的灰色可能比预期的更小的财政负担。
